title: LazyVM settings
description: Every LazyVM setting, with its default. List only the settings you want to change: in LazyVM.Settings.json for every VM on this host, or in a VM's VM.json for that VM alone. Hover a setting's name to see what it does.

$schema.description: Points your editor at this schema, for autocomplete and checking. Leave it as it is.

VHDXRoot.description: Where each VM's configuration and Windows disk are kept, in a folder named after the VM. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

OSDiskSizeGB.description: Size of the Windows disk in GB. It grows as needed up to this size.

MemStartGB.description: Memory the VM starts with, in GB. 8 is Microsoft's minimum for a Dev Drive; dynamic memory releases it when the VM is idle.

MemMinGB.description: The least memory dynamic memory may shrink the VM to, in GB.

MemMaxGB.description: The most memory dynamic memory may give the VM, in GB.

EnableEnhancedSession.description: Use Enhanced Session Mode in VMConnect: clipboard, drive and audio redirection over the VMBus, with no network setup.

SwitchName.description: The Hyper-V virtual switch the VM connects to. 'Default Switch' gives NAT and DHCP automatically.

NatSwitchName.description: Fallback only: if SwitchName does not exist, an internal switch with this name is created, with NAT.

NatSubnet.description: Fallback only: the NAT network for NatSwitchName.

NatHostIP.description: Fallback only: the host's address on the NAT network.

ISOPath.description: The Windows 11 Enterprise evaluation ISO. If it is not found here, the ISO folder is searched for one. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

ISOMinSizeGB.description: An ISO smaller than this, in GB, is treated as a failed download.

ISOSearchRoot.description: The folder searched for a Windows ISO when ISOPath does not exist. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

ISODownloadPage.description: Where to download the Windows 11 Enterprise evaluation. Opened for you when no ISO is found.

SQLIsoPath.description: The SQL Server installation ISO. Downloaded from SQLIsoUrl when missing. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

SQLIsoUrl.description: Where the SQL Server ISO is downloaded from. SQL Server 2025 Enterprise Developer: every Enterprise feature, free for development and test.

SQLDiskPath.description: The SQL data disk. It is never deleted by a rebuild, so databases survive one. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

SQLDiskSizeGB.description: Size of the SQL data disk in GB. It grows as needed up to this size.

MoveSqlDataToDataDisk.description: Move an existing SQL Server instance's user databases and tempdb onto the data disk. Files are copied and checked before the originals go. master, model and msdb are never moved.

SQLInstallMinutes.description: How long the SQL Server install may take before it is treated as failed, in minutes.

UseDevDrive.description: Give the VM a Dev Drive: a ReFS volume with Defender performance mode, for source code and builds. It is never deleted by a rebuild.

DevDrivePath.description: The Dev Drive disk on the host. Keep it here, not inside the VM: a rebuild replaces the VM's own disks. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

DevDriveSizeGB.description: Size of the Dev Drive in GB. Dev Drive needs at least 50.

DevDriveLetter.description: The Dev Drive's letter inside the VM.

DevDriveFilters.description: Extra file system filters allowed on the Dev Drive. Everything except antivirus is detached by default, which is where the speed comes from. 'PrjFlt' for Live Unit Testing, 'WinSetupMon' if TEMP is on the drive, 'bindFlt' and 'wcifs' for containers.

CheckpointDir.description: Where Hyper-V checkpoints of the VM are kept. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

VSSettingsBackup.description: Where the Visual Studio settings export is kept between rebuilds. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

LogFile.description: The VM's log file. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

LogMaxSizeMB.description: When the log is bigger than this, in MB, it is set aside and a new one started.

CredStoreDir.description: Where the encrypted guest passwords and their key are kept. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

StateDir.description: Where the guest's captured state (databases, settings, files) is kept for a rebuild. A path inside the LazyVM folder (like 'VMs') or a full path on another drive (like 'E:\VMs'). {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

GuestAdminUser.description: The VM's administrator account, when none has been stored with Set-LazyVMCredential.

GuestComputerName.description: The VM's computer name. {VM} is replaced by the VM's name.

GuestTimeZone.description: The VM's time zone, as Windows names it (Get-TimeZone -ListAvailable).

GuestSetupDir.description: A working folder inside the VM for installers and captured files.

GuestDataDriveLetter.description: Preferred letter for the SQL data disk inside the VM. If it is taken, another is chosen and every SQL path follows it.

SqlDataFolder.description: Folder on the SQL data disk for database files.

SqlLogFolder.description: Folder on the SQL data disk for transaction logs.

SqlTempFolder.description: Folder on the SQL data disk for tempdb.

SqlBackupFolder.description: Folder on the SQL data disk for backups.

GuestWaitMinutes.description: How long to wait for Windows to install and reach the desktop, in minutes.

GuestNetworkWaitMinutes.description: How long to wait for the VM's network before downloads, in minutes.

VSInstallMinutes.description: How long each Visual Studio Installer product (Visual Studio, SSMS) may take to install, in minutes.

InstallerBootstrappers.description: The Visual Studio Installer bootstrapper for each channel a tooling list uses. {edition} becomes the edition in lower case, so Microsoft.VisualStudio.Product.Community uses vs_community.exe. Listing this setting replaces the whole table, so copy it and add to it.

AppSettings.description: Application settings carried across a rebuild: each registry key is exported by a capture and imported by a restore, after the application has been reinstalled.

RegistryKey.description: The registry key to carry across, starting HKCU\ or HKLM\.

RebuildThresholdDays.description: How many days before the Windows evaluation expires the daily maintenance acts: it rearms if it can, and rebuilds only when it cannot.

DeleteRetiredDiskOnSuccess.description: Delete the old Windows disk once a rebuilt VM has been checked. false keeps every generation, which adds up fast.

GuestProjectPaths.description: Folders inside the VM captured and carried across a rebuild. The Dev Drive needs none of this: it survives a rebuild on its own.

ProjectExcludeDirs.description: Folder names left out when capturing GuestProjectPaths.

MaxProjectCaptureGB.description: The most project files a capture will copy, in GB.

GuestRestoreRoot.description: Where captured project folders are restored inside the VM.

ToolingCheckpointsToKeep.description: How many tooling checkpoints to keep. Older ones are removed.

ToolingHistoryDays.description: How many days of daily copies of the tooling list to keep.

ToolingWingetExclude.description: winget packages never recorded in the tooling list: ones that come with Windows, and products the Visual Studio Installer manages. Wildcards allowed. Listing this setting replaces the whole list, so copy it and add to it.

ToolingWingetCheck.description: winget ids to check for directly, for packages winget can match but leaves out of its export.

MaintenanceTime.description: When the VM's daily maintenance runs, 24-hour time on the host. New-LazyVM sets each new VM an hour after the latest existing one.
